# CANDIDATE: VWAP_OVERNIGHT_GRINDER_TOP_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-23  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We aim to capture the VWAP continuation edge by identifying specific VWAP reclaim/rejection combinations that signal intraday directional bias. The edge exists because when the first three RTH closes are on one side of the session VWAP, the first morning bar continuing that trend (via breakout or pullback) has a higher probability of follow-through, especially when confirmed by volume and proximity conditions.

## Mechanism

The trigger uses VWAP as an anchor, requiring: (1) volume above `vol_mult` times average, (2) price within `proximity_dollars` of VWAP, (3) body size exceeding `body_min_cents` over `lookback_bars`, (4) VWAP reclaim (close above VWAP after being below) or rejection (close below VWAP after being above). Entry occurs at the next bar open. Exit uses chart stop (primary invalidation: SPY closes 3-min candle above/below rejected level + $0.50 buffer) with catastrophe premium stop at `premium_stop_pct` of entry, TP1 at `tp1_premium_pct` (selling `tp1_qty_fraction` of qty), runner targeting `runner_target_pct`, and profit-lock arming at `profit_lock_threshold_pct` with stop offset `profit_lock_stop_offset_pct`. Requires EMA ribbon agreement (`require_ribbon_agreement=true`) with minimum spread `ribbon_min_spread_cents`.
